input.quote: (a) EXCEPT WITH RESPECT TO CONTRACTOR'S OBLIGATIONS PURSUANT TO PARAGRAPH 9 HEREOF, CONTRACTOR'S MAXIMUM LIABILITY TO COMPANY ARISING FOR ANY REASON RELATING TO CONTRACTOR'S PERFORMANCE OF SERVICES UNDER A STATEMENT OF WORK SHALL BE LIMITED TO THE AMOUNT OF FEES PAID TO CONTRACTOR FOR THE PERFORMANCE OF SUCH SERVICES.
input.rationale: The cap in § 7(a) is set at fees actually paid (Contractor's cap is limited further to fees paid under the particular Statement of Work), with no 12-month look-back, no USD 1,000,000 floor and no "paid or payable" language, so Contractor's exposure can be far below the playbook minimum. The only carve-out cross-references "Paragraph 9", which is the Independent Contractor clause (the Agreement contains no indemnification section despite the § 7 caption), so there are effectively no carve-outs for confidentiality (§ 8), IP infringement warranty (§ 5(c)), gross negligence, willful misconduct or fraud, and nothing confirms that Company's fee payments sit outside the cap. The mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages in § 7(b) is acceptable. Redline conforms § 7(a) to the preferred position: mutual cap at the greater of 12 months' fees or USD 1,000,000, uncapped Excluded Claims, and payment obligations excluded from the cap. Fallback: 12 months' fees with carve-outs at least for indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and willful misconduct.

ops.oldText: (a) EXCEPT WITH RESPECT TO CONTRACTOR'S OBLIGATIONS PURSUANT TO PARAGRAPH 9 HEREOF, CONTRACTOR'S MAXIMUM LIABILITY TO COMPANY ARISING FOR ANY REASON RELATING TO CONTRACTOR'S PERFORMANCE OF SERVICES UNDER A STATEMENT OF WORK SHALL BE LIMITED TO THE AMOUNT OF FEES PAID TO CONTRACTOR FOR THE PERFORMANCE OF SUCH SERVICES. COMPANYS' MAXIMUM LIABILITY TO CONTRACTOR FOR ANY REASON ARISING OUT OF THIS AGREEMENT SHALL BE LIMITED TO THE AMOUNT OF FEES PAID TO CONTRACTOR.
ops.newText: (a) EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, EACH PARTY'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT EXCEED THE GREATER OF (I) THE FEES PAID OR PAYABLE BY COMPANY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE CLAIM AND (II) ONE MILLION U.S. DOLLARS (USD 1,000,000). "EXCLUDED CLAIMS" MEANS A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY, DATA PROTECTION OR SECURITY OBLIGATIONS, ITS INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS, ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILLFUL MISCONDUCT OR FRAUD, AND ITS INFRINGEMENT OF THE OTHER PARTY'S INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS. COMPANY'S OBLIGATION TO PAY FEES DUE UNDER THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT BE CONSIDERED DAMAGES SUBJECT TO THIS LIMITATION.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have made the cap mutual and set it at the greater of twelve (12) months' fees or USD 1,000,000, because a cap limited to the fees paid under a single Statement of Work leaves us without a meaningful remedy. We also added the standard uncapped carve-outs (confidentiality, data protection/security, indemnification, gross negligence, willful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement) in place of the prior cross-reference to Paragraph 9, which is the independent contractor clause, and confirmed our fee payments are not "damages" subject to the cap.
proposal.summary: Make the liability cap mutual at the greater of 12 months' fees or USD 1,000,000 and add uncapped carve-outs.
